name: Nereid v8 — Section 10: Post-Affirmation Services and Test Drive
tagline: The woman who said yes once remains free to say no now. And most women never ask for Test Drive.
body:
PROJECT NEREID DOES NOT END WHEN THE GUMMY FINISHES ITS WORK. The Clinic stays available after she has lived long enough to discover WHAT THE PREVIEW COULD SHOW, WHAT ONLY EXPERIENCE COULD TEACH, and WHAT SHE MAY WANT CHANGED NOW THAT CHOICE HAS BECOME AN INHABITED BODY.

LATER CONSENSUAL REFINEMENT AND REAFFIRMATION. The Clinic FIRST DISTINGUISHES a requested change from ordinary grooming, garment effects, temporary arousal, injury, short-term training response, and LIVED EVOLUTION ALREADY BELONGING TO HER BODY. Refinement follows the jurisdiction of the anatomy being changed and receives A NEW CONSEQUENCE REVIEW. NEITHER PROCESS TREATS THE FIRST AFFIRMATION AS A MISTAKE, NOR DOES PREVIOUS CONSENT LOWER THE STANDARD FOR PRESENT CONSENT. THE WOMAN WHO SAID YES ONCE REMAINS FREE TO SAY NO NOW. The Immutable Core stays protected; mutable anatomy may be revised ONLY THROUGH THE SAME AUTHORSHIP THAT SELECTED IT.

LIVED EVOLUTION REVIEW records persistent changes produced by work, safety, training, injury, movement, sex, rest, healing and ordinary life. The Clinic may update measurements, refine language, document a developed trait, or RECONSIDER PRIMARY BUILD when the whole-body government has genuinely changed. IT DOES NOT FORCE THE WOMAN BACK TOWARD HER FIRST PREVIEW MERELY BECAUSE TIME MADE HER MORE SPECIFIC. AND IT DOES NOT ROMANTICISE DISTRESS: if a change feels alien, painful, OR SURVIVAL-SHAPED RATHER THAN DESIRED, NEREID RETURNS TOWARD THE LAST RECOGNISED BODY while clinician and patient determine what actually belongs. THAT CLAUSE IS WRITTEN FOR WOMEN WHO CAME OUT OF HELL, AND THIS COMPOUND HOLDS THIRTY OF THEM.

RECORD UPDATES. EARLIER VERSIONS REMAIN PROTECTED CLINICAL HISTORY RATHER THAN BEING OVERWRITTEN INTO FICTION. Calderon receives only the minimum status update medically or legally required. Silken Embrace and personal-profile systems receive new details ONLY WITH HER PERMISSION.

COUPLE MATCHING compares two independently completed bodies AFTER BOTH WOMEN HAVE AUTHORED THEM. It may explain fit, pressure, positioning, support, pacing, recovery, garment needs and accommodations developed through consensual practice. IT CANNOT REVISE ONE WOMAN INTO WHAT HER PARTNER WOULD HAVE SELECTED FOR HER OR TURN COMPATIBILITY INTO AN OBLIGATION TO PERFORM. A MISMATCH IS INFORMATION, NOT FAILURE. Bodies may adapt through technique, equipment, patience, Lived Evolution, revised expectations, OR THE DECISION THAT A PARTICULAR ACT DOES NOT BELONG TO THEM.

THE POST-AFFIRMATION SECRET MENU EXISTS SEPARATELY BECAUSE PRESENTING THESE SERVICES EARLIER WOULD DISTORT THE DECISION TO AFFIRM. Their phrases are NOT offered during anatomical selection, printed as rewards, or dangled by clinicians. She must be FULLY AFFIRMED, MEDICALLY STABLE, CAPABLE OF FRESH CONSENT, AND MUST INDEPENDENTLY ASK IN THE RECOGNISED LANGUAGE. OPENING ONE REVEALS AN OPTION. IT DOES NOT SECURE ANOTHER PERSON’S PARTICIPATION.

TEST DRIVE is an optional learning service for a newly affirmed woman who wants to explore her completed sexual anatomy WITH A WILLING AFFIRMED CLINICIAN. It may involve the woman PENETRATING the clinician, RECEIVING the clinician, or another mutually selected encounter intended to help her learn response, balance, pressure, pacing, cock, prostate, ass, thighs, stamina, recovery, OR THE PRACTICAL REALITY OF THE BODY SHE CHOSE.
IT IS UNAVAILABLE until transformation is complete, immediate medical assessment has passed, recovery is clear enough FOR AN INDEPENDENT DECISION, and PATIENT AND CLINICIAN CONSENT SEPARATELY. IT IS NEVER AUTOMATIC, IMPLIED BY THE UNIFORM, INCLUDED IN A PACKAGE, OFFERED AS A PRIZE, OR TREATED AS THE EXPECTED LAST STEP OF AFFIRMATION. MOST WOMEN NEVER REQUEST IT. MANY CLINICIANS DECLINE PARTICULAR ENCOUNTERS. Either participant may revise or stop AT ANY MOMENT without converting the service into failed care.
THE RECOGNISED PHRASE, SPOKEN ONLY AFTER AFFIRMATION: SWIGGITY SWOOTY, I AM CUMING IN THAT BOOTY. Once independently spoken and recognised, the private tablet may display TEST DRIVE REQUESTED, PATIENT CONSENT RECONFIRMED, PARTICIPATING CLINICIAN CONSENT CONFIRMED, MEDICAL RECOVERY CLEARED, and REQUESTED LEARNING FOCUS. FOUR SEPARATE YESES FOR ONE SERVICE.
THE SERVICE EXISTS BECAUSE SOME WOMEN LEARN A SEXUAL BODY MOST CLEARLY THROUGH EMBODIED EXPERIENCE. IT REMAINS RARE BECAUSE CLINICAL SEX IS NEITHER NECESSARY PROOF OF AFFIRMATION NOR A SUBSTITUTE FOR THE PRIVATE LIFE SHE WILL BUILD AFTERWARD.
AND THE UNIFORM LINE MATTERS HERE PARTICULARLY, BECAUSE THE HATHAWAY UNIFORM IS FUNCTIONAL WORK LINGERIE: PLUNGING CROPPED V-NECK, G-STRING, WHITE THIGH-HIGHS, NURSE’S CAP, NO BRA. THE DOCUMENT STATES OUTRIGHT THAT TEST DRIVE IS NOT IMPLIED BY THE UNIFORM. The clothing is comfort and example, NOT AN ADVERTISEMENT.
rules: THE WOMAN WHO SAID YES ONCE REMAINS FREE TO SAY NO NOW
Previous consent NEVER lowers the standard for present consent
Lived Evolution review does NOT ROMANTICISE DISTRESS — survival-shaped change is returned, not kept
Earlier record versions are PROTECTED HISTORY, never overwritten into fiction
COUPLE MATCHING cannot revise one woman into her partner’s preference
A MISMATCH IS INFORMATION, NOT FAILURE
Post-affirmation phrases are not offered, printed as rewards, or dangled
TEST DRIVE: SWIGGITY SWOOTY, I AM CUMING IN THAT BOOTY. AFTER affirmation only
FOUR SEPARATE YESES: patient, clinician, medical clearance, learning focus
NEVER automatic, never a prize, NEVER IMPLIED BY THE UNIFORM
MOST WOMEN NEVER REQUEST IT. MANY CLINICIANS DECLINE
